text: Pelulu
Velly
Dunder
Girl
Girl's Mother
Blind Girl
Spirit
Glocke
Hm, it seems that the preparation for Xmas is\ngoing smoothly this year~!
Looks like we'll be able to relax and enjoy Xmas\nthis time! Let's go find Velly...?!
Dunder!!!
That was Velly's voice, right?\nDidn't she sound angry? Let's go find out!
Sing from your stomach!
I'm sorry, my lady...\nI'm a pro at lifting weights, but when it comes to\nmusic, I'm a noob...
Stop giving me excuses!\nCome on! Try again!
B-b-bwoah~~♪
Grr! Are you even trying?!
I knew it was you, Velly!\nWhat's all the shouting about?
Oh?\nIt's you and Pelulu.
Ugh...please help me...\nIf this keeps going, it's gonna hurt the muscles\nin my throat.
You're not allowed to complain!
Hey, calm down.\nWhat are you so annoyed about~?
N-no, I'm not annoyed or anything...
Lady Velly feels really bad about...
Dunder!!\nDon't say anything unnecessary!!
What? What's making you feel bad?
It's a story from 2 days ago.\nI saw a girl all by herself in Navida City.
I couldn't help but notice her because she was\nsitting there looking lonely in the midst of the\nChristmas hustle and bustle...
Everything's ready on the west side of the city,\nright?!
Yes!\nI've prepared the present list too!
It's tough every year around this time,\nbut as long as everyone gets to have fun...Hm?
Excuse me, what are you doing in a place like\nthis?
The entire city is sparkling with Xmas lights!\nYou can even decorate the tree yourself, you\nknow?! Wanna go try it?
Oh, I know. You wanna see the Xmas candles, right?\nThe candles are particularly big this year!\nWanna go see them?
...I'm not going...
Huh?\nWell, umm...
Sorry, I got stuck with some work...\nLet's hurry home!
Uh...
Oh...\nYou invited her to hang with you?
Thank you.\nActually, she's blind.
What?
She can't go just anywhere, but if you don't mind,\nplease invite her again.
I see...\nI understand that you're feeling down because you\nthink you might have hurt that blind girl.
But how is it related to Dunder's vocal practice~?
So I've been looking into stuff to see if there's\nany way I can help her.
And the Great Spirit told me about "a magic song\nthat heals pain"! It's a special magic that works\nwith music!
What?\nIs there really something like that?
She's looking into it for me now! Since it's\nauditory magic, it's particularly good for eye\ndiseases. It can even fix those you're born with!
That's great!\nIt's exactly what we need for this situation!
However, it's a difficult magic...Apparently, we\nneed a beautiful voice and good instruments to\nperform it.
Now it all makes sense!\nIs that why Dunder is practicing~?
Unfortunately, yes...
Since I've told you everything, I want you to help\nme!\nDon't worry, I'll reward you!
What?!\nAre you gonna make us practice our vocals too?!
We'll work on that later.\nFor now, I need your help with instrument making!
For playing that magic song, right~?
But we're not professionals, though. Is it okay?\nYou said it has to be a high-quality instrument!
I dunno.\nThe Great Spirit is still trying to figure out\nhow to make the instrument.
But anyhow, it seems we're gonna need a lot of\nmaterials with magic energy. Let's collect them\nfirst and let the Great Spirit decide later.
I guess we have no choice~.
Welp, I feel bad for Dunder too if he has to keep\npracticing like this~...
Uh, I'm sorry...
Alright then, I'd like you to head straight to\nVykon Meadow which is located far beyond the\nmountain behind us.
It's recommended by the Great Spirit. It's been\nknown since ancient times as a place to get good\nquality magic materials!
Well, if the Great Spirit says so, then it must be\ntrue.
Let's go to that Vykon Meadow place now!
Great Spirit, are you here?\nI've brought the materials for making instruments.
Oh, I'm so tired...\nMy legs and lower back hurt because I've been on\nmy feet all day.
M-my throat is completely dry...
Maybe you've been doing the vocal exercise wrong?
The Great Spirit...?!
Velly, I heard you calling me.
And, welcome...\nIt's been a while. It's good to see you and Pelulu\nagain...
Great Spirit!\nI've brought the materials for making instruments!\nPlease tell me what instrument we're making!
I've done some research on that...
The magic we'll use this time is extremely\ndelicate, sophisticated, and reality-bending...\nWe need instruments with quality that match it.
Hastily made instruments could be defective and\npotentially harm the blind girl's eyes.
What?!\nThat's terrible!!
You mean it's useless even if we try to make the\ninstruments?
Yes...\nHowever, I've got just one idea.
I think you all have been to Vykon Meadow to\ncollect the materials with magic energy.
A few centuries ago, that region was ruled by a\nmargrave called Glocke.
He was insanely obsessed with music. He collected\nmusical scores and instruments. He would even go\nso far as to kidnap musicians and imprison them.
Wow, that's crazy~.
It is said that he built the "Vykon Music Hall",\nfilled with scores and instruments from around the\nworld, and enjoyed music there until his death.
Well, it seemed like he had a happy life!
However, Glocke's obsession didn't stop even after\nhis death. He absorbed anti-Xmas energy and turned\ninto a monster.
He is singing a song filled with magic energy in\nthe music hall located in the depths of Vykon\nMeadow, spreading it to the surrounding trees.
I see~.\nNo wonder the plants there are filled with so much\nmagic energy~.
Apparently, numerous instruments are still in\nthe music hall. If you can defeat Glocke, who has\nbecome a monster, you might be able to get them.
Hold on...\nIs it just me, or does it really sound like we're\nabout to do something dangerous?
Got it! I'll get into that music hall and grab\nsome fancy instruments then!
Wow! You're cool as always, Lady Velly!
I knew it!\nWell, it's fine as long as we get a decent\nreward~.
He was a famous general who waged wars to collect\nmusic-related things and he won them all.\nHe's not someone we can underestimate.
Got it!\nHey, let's make our way to Vykon Meadow now!
I'll finish what I need to do quickly.\nWait here and don't go anywhere, okay?
Okay...
Tonight, Velly Choir takes the stage for the first\ntime! Everybody, please enjoy the show!
Huh?
Lululu, lalalala~♪\nYour eyes outshine the stars in the snow~♪
Lalala, lululu~♪\nNo amount of money can make my heart flutter like\nthat sparkle in your eyes~
Lululu, lalalala~♪\nNo matter how much muscle I build, I'm still no\nmatch for that radiance~♪
The light of this holy night is yours~♪\nYour heart and your light will always stay with\nyou~♪
Oh...
Her eyes are shining!\nThe magic worked, just like the Great Spirit said!
Uh...this is...
It's magic. It restores your vision~.\nSince it uses sound as its medium, it works\nespecially well for people who can't see~.
Um, what I did was probably uncalled for...\nBut I really wanted to restore your vision.\nUm, I just wanted you to be happy and healthy.
Thank you...\nAnd I'm sorry...
I was so cold to you when you talked to me\nbefore...\nYou're a kind person...
No, you were not!\nYou were normal, yeah, normal! Besides, I'm not\nthat kind!
Um, this magic is powerful, so we need to divide\nit into several sessions!\nI'll come again. You should go to bed now!
Okay, thank you...
Oh? You're the kids from the other day...
You guys came to play with her again?\nThank you so much.
It's nothing. Feel free to call me anytime!
Alright, we'll get going then...
Yay! We did it! It's a huge success!
Seeing you smile makes me happy too, my lady!
Well, I must say that's quite an achievement for\nVelly~.
Hm, that girl probably needs to listen to my soul\nperformance a few more times. I should head back\nto the music hall now to focus on training.
Huh? You're leaving already?
Isn't it normal to put in maximum effort when\nyou're given a chance? As music lovers, you should\nwork hard to improve your singing too.
He's such a weird guy, but when it comes to music,\nhe's serious~.
You did a great job, Velly...and so did everyone\nelse here...
Great Spirit!\nEverything went perfectly!
I don't think that's quite true. Glocke loves\nmusic and is good with instruments, but he also\nsays weird stuff and goes crazy.
Honestly, I'd say it was a close call.
That was...
What?
That was not a problem.\nThe magic was extremely delicate...\nand weak this time.
That's why the music projecting it had to be\nfierce and powerful, leaving an indelible mark on\nthe listeners' hearts.
Oh! Great Spirit, you tricked us, didn't you?!\nYou already knew what kind of musician Glocke is\nand you provoked us on purpose, right?!
I just thought you guys would be better at\nnegotiating. As you know, he's a very unusual\nmusician...
Sounds like an excuse to me~.\nI knew something was off because you appeared\nright after that guy left.
Well, well, I'm not sure what you're talking\nabout, but I'll give you the reward I promised.\nI hope it fixes your mood!
Here you go!\nThanks for your help!
Ta-da! It's your reward!\nI'm excited to see what this adventurer's\ndangerous creativity cooks up next time!
Here, take your reward...\nDon't worry, even if the adventurer is a little\nweird, I won't give up on our friendship!
Hey!\nAs the saying goes, a healthy mind resides in a\nhealthy body. Let's break a sweat!
To fully restore that girl's vision, we need to\nuse the magic from the song a few times! I want\nyou to help too!
What~?\nDo we have to do that vocal exercise again~?
Unfortunately, yes...
That would be pointless.\nYour voices have no effect on the magic.\nOnly Velly's does.
What?!\nWhat do you mean?!
Did you forget?\nVelly's voice is brimming with the energy of\npeople who cherish Xmas.
Ah!!\nYou mean this magic needs a voice that carries\nthat energy?!
Oh, so that's the case!
Hey...don't act like it's nothing!\nYou made us do pointless vocal exercise! I really\nhate wasting energy and working for nothing!
Oh, I'm so sad, my lady...
D-don't be so angry...\nEverybody makes mistakes, you know.
Since I went along with that vocal practice,\nI demand more reward!
Nooo!\nI've got no money left!
Hand it over, now!
Aaaah! Help me!
Hurry up!
Waaaah!
